selection_reasons: Both common interfaces deliver the declared actual source and complete all 32 own-history sessions per arm; no capacity or short-reference failure in this prefix.
I2 has larger full-input headroom on the preselected fixed early/middle/late actual v1 states.
I2 lowers actual Writer tokens in all four arms; overall scoring cost and semantic results are mixed and retained.

granularity.observation: last actual state of each own development-user eight-session prefix; repeated historical snapshots excluded
limits: Unit counts and text lengths are description, not improvement or independent samples.
Different arms and interfaces have different own evolved states.
Text change and unit-ID change are not semantic damage.

fixed_source_case_summary.selection: First chronological I1 B0 current-boundary-source rejection, before I2 M outputs; same original session matched in all four arms.
fixed_source_case_summary.I1: All four actual states omitted the current career-change intent; B1 proposed it but overlap rejection prevented storage.
fixed_source_case_summary.I2: B0/M store the source-supported intent and work-related mental-health reason; B1 stores intent without the explicit causal link; B2 rejected and omitted.
fixed_source_case_summary.limits: One fixed case, own histories differ; no completed employment change and no aggregate advantage claim.

limits: A common interface selection, not a final method or product candidate.
Mixed official update and QA results do not establish semantic improvement from deduplication.
I2 B0 official aggregate error remains; actual label counts are available separately, not replaced with zero.
Duplicate-target refusals and partial commits remain first-attempt failures with gaps.
Own histories differ across arms and conditions; fixed-state capacity contrasts are separate.
First eight sessions do not establish long-history stability.
Conditional roles and relations are not assumed used merely from the arm label.
Writer/Reader/Judge use existing Qwen3.6; Judge is not independent.
